question: Which amongst the following Sultans shifted his capital from Delhi to Daulatabad?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Muhammad Bin Tughlaq**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhammad Bin Tughlaq** was the Sultan who shifted his capital from Delhi to Daulatabad.
 
• This decision was made during his reign in the early 14th century.
 
• The move was intended to help control the Deccan region more effectively and to protect the capital from Mongol invasions.
 
• However, the decision proved to be a failure due to logistical issues and the hardships it caused to the people.
 
• Eventually, the capital was moved back to Delhi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Muhammad Bin Tughlaq** ruled from 1325 to 1351 and is known for his ambitious but often impractical projects.
 
• He was the second ruler of the Tughlaq dynasty.
 
• His reign is marked by several bold experiments in governance, including the introduction of token currency and tax reforms.
 
• Despite his intelligence and vision, many of his policies were considered ahead of their time and failed due to poor execution.
 
• His decision to shift the capital is often cited as a classic example of his ambitious but flawed administrative decisions.
